findings.problem: Several records convert imprecise, one-sided, or narrative-relative Chinese chronology into unjustified Western intervals or points. Most notably, 建中三年之後 becomes AD 787–789, 元和十年之後 becomes AD 815, and a Yuanhe-13 sequence is treated as AD 836–840; Dali is also narrowed to AD 777–779 without source support.
findings.action: Pin independent source-specific chronology and replace each value with source-supported point, period, or one-sided bounds. Remove any date/hint that remains unsupported, then submit the repaired extraction for fresh independent audit.
